summary: Exact Poisson p-values were computed as 1 - P(N <= n - 1 | b), which cancels to zero below about 1e-16.

database_specific.introduced_basis: the defective lines are in the repository's first commit, the 0.3.0 import; earlier releases are not in this repository
database_specific.fixed_basis: 0.4.0 was released (merge 9870a35, version 0.4.0) without a release tag or manifest

observables: exact Poisson p-values and significances (likelihood_limits.py profile-significance, statistical_toys.py boundary); the Garwood lower end
impact.bias: p-values below about 1e-16 came out as 0: n = 60, b = 5 returned 0 instead of 7.65e-43, so the significance was infinite or undefined
impact.trigger: a large excess over a small background (p below about 1e-16)

remedy: recompute the p-value and significance with a release that has the fix (0.4.0 or later); outputs now carry log_p_value_exact_poisson
